'''Gaulus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that at one time hosted a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Alliance Base 16|base]]. An [[espionage droid]] infiltrated the base and transmitted the location to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and thus the base was destroyed shortly after.<ref name="RASB" />
